newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek towns flooded by heavy rains, three dead.
newsitem.headline: Greek towns flooded by heavy rains, three dead.

text.p: Torrential weekend rains flooded towns in northern Greece, leaving three dead, hundreds of homes knee-deep in water and scores of cars ruined, police said on Sunday.
Village streets were turned into raging rivers. Main road links were washed away and cars were stacked in crumpled heaps by flash floods, police said.
Xanthi, north of Salonika, was among the hardest hit towns but villages through the region had suffered heavy damages, the police said. Meteorologists predicted more storms to come.
